name: controllers
description: Query controllers of remotes with optional filtering options

params.name: pending
params.description: Include a list of attributes whose changes are currently pending.

params.name: remotes
params.description: Only return controllers from the specified remotes.

params.name: running
params.description: If true shows the running configuration, otherwise the pending configuration.

params.name: ty
params.description: Only list sdn controllers of specific type

returns.description: Get a list of controllers fitting the filtering criteria.

items.description: SDN controller with additional information about which remote it belongs to

asn.description: The local ASN of the controller. BGP & EVPN only.

bgp-mode.description:
Whether to use eBGP or iBGP. Auto mode chooses depending on BGP controller
or falls back to iBGP.

bgp-multipath-as-relax.description:
Consider different AS paths of equal length for multipath computation.
BGP only.

ebgp-multihop.description:
Set maximum amount of hops for eBGP peers. Needs ebgp set to 1. BGP
only.

isis-domain.description: Name of the IS-IS domain. IS-IS only.

isis-ifaces.description:
Comma-separated list of interfaces where IS-IS should be active. IS-IS
only.

isis-net.description: Network Entity title for this node in the IS-IS network. IS-IS only.

loopback.description:
Name of the loopback/dummy interface that provides the Router-IP. BGP
only.

node.description: Node(s) where this controller is active.

peer-group-name.description: Name of the peer group for this EVPN controller

peers.description: Comma-separated list of the peers IP addresses.

pending.description: Changes that have not yet been applied to the running configuration.

state.description: The state of an SDN object.

permissions.description:
The user needs to have at least the `Resource.Audit` privilege under `/resource`.
        Only controllers from remotes for which the user has `Resource.Audit` on `/resource/{remote_name}`
        will be included in the returned list.
